🎙
Statement
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the Caspian Environmental Summit
(Turkmenbashi, October 9, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
The Caspian Sea is of immense
environmental, economic, transport
and, of course,
cultural and historical importance
to all of us as one of the cradles of Eurasian civilisation.
Russia attaches the highest priority to working with its partners to protect and preserve the Caspian Sea’s ecosystem.
Governments, businesses, civil society organisations and a wide range of scientists and specialists are actively involved in these efforts.
❗️
I share the view expressed by my colleagues that the declining water level of the Caspian Sea is one of the most pressing challenges we face today
.
According to our estimates, over the past 20 years,
some 20,000 square kilometres along the Russian section of the Caspian coastline alone have dried up
. Russia has to allocate substantial budget funds every year to dredging operations to keep shipping routes navigable.
Research by Russian and foreign experts indicates that
the main cause of the Caspian Sea’s declining water level is climate change
.
☝️
Our countries need to develop joint measures to preserve the Caspian Sea’s ecosystem
. We believe it is essential to make full use of existing international institutions for this purpose. I am referring primarily to
the Conference of the Parties to the Framework Convention for the Protection of the Marine Environment of the Caspian Sea
– the so-called
Tehran Convention of 2003
.
I would also like to mention
Russia’s proposal to create a digital copy of the Caspian Sea
. This would be a highly accurate virtual model using AI algorithms to analyse changes in evaporation, precipitation and river inflows. The model could be used to produce
reliable projections
of changes in the Caspian Sea’s water level.
I would stress that large-scale efforts to preserve the Caspian ecosystem require
not only financial resources
and intergovernmental mechanisms,
but also highly qualified specialists
with expertise across a wide range of natural sciences. Training such specialists is a pressing task.
🤝
Russia has always supported, and will continue to support, closer cooperation among our countries to preserve the Caspian region’s ecosystem
, ensure its sustainable growth and improve people’s quality of life.

Joint Statement
by the Heads of State of the Commonwealth of Independent States on Preserving Historical Memory
(Turkmenbashi, October 9, 2026)
🇦🇲
🇧🇾
🇰🇿
🇰🇬
🇷🇺
🇹🇯
🇹🇲

We, the Heads of State of the Commonwealth of Independent States – the Republic of Armenia, the Republic of Belarus, the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Kyrgyz Republic, the Russian Federation, the Republic of Tajikistan, Turkmenistan and the Republic of Uzbekistan,
Guided by the bonds of friendship, solidarity and mutual respect
that run throughout the history of relations between our peoples,
Reaffirming
our commitment to the purposes and principles of
the Charter of the United Nations
, including the development of friendly relations among states, international cooperation and the sovereign equality of states, and reaffirming the importance of preserving the universal character of the UN,
Recognising
the historical significance of the establishment of the Commonwealth of Independent States 35 years ago and the value of development within a shared cultural and civilisational space, as well as the centuries-old historical, cultural and humanitarian ties between the peoples of our states,
Preserving
with deep respect the memory of the heroic feats of our forebears, who defended freedom and independence during
the Great Patriotic War of 1941–1945
, and paying tribute to their constructive work, which ensured post-war recovery and outstanding achievements in various fields, including space exploration and the advancement of world science and culture,
Convinced
that respect for the past and a thorough understanding of it provide a firm foundation for national harmony, stronger intercultural dialogue, and relations of trust and solidarity among and within countries,
☝️
Declare that preserving historical memory is an effective means of countering all manifestations of discrimination, racism, xenophobia and all forms of intolerance.
Affirm
that knowledge of history helps to promptly identify and counter attempts to distort the past and spread disinformation and extremism that undermine the foundations of peaceful coexistence.
Recognise
the need to critically assess the complex interconnections between the past, present and future and to ensure the accuracy of historical interpretations through careful study of sources and historical scholarship.
Emphasise
the importance of studying our shared history and support the advancement of historical scholarship and access to history education.
🌐
Call on the international community to join efforts to preserve historical memory and historical truth, strengthen peace, mutual respect and trust among peoples
, and pass on to future generations the experience of peaceful and constructive cooperation in accordance with universally recognised norms of international law, while consistently upholding the principle that the glorification of Nazism, fascism and other destructive ideologies is unacceptable.
🤝
Seek to expand cooperation in promoting historical awareness through open, honest, professional and depoliticised dialogue by
:
•
Raising
public awareness of commemorative dates and protecting historical sites and memorials that reflect milestones in the development of relations among CIS Member States;
•
Organising
thematic events, exhibitions, screenings of documentaries and historical feature films, academic and practical conferences, forums and expert discussions;
•
Expanding
and deepening contacts among scholars, archivists, archaeologists, movements dedicated to locating and recovering the remains of fallen soldiers, youth and volunteer movements, as well as cooperation among educational, academic and research institutions;
•
Coordinating
the efforts of the academic community and experts through
the International Association (Commission) of Historians and Archivists of the CIS Member States
and bilateral mechanisms for cooperation among historians, with a view to bringing closer together the approaches, terminology and methodologies used to describe events in our shared past.

🎙
Statement
by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at the restricted-format meeting of the CIS Council of Heads of State
(Turkmenbashi, October 9, 2026)
💬
Vladimir Putin:
Over the past three and a half decades,
the Commonwealth of Independent States
(
#CIS
) has come a long way, establishing itself as
a respected regional integration association
.
It is thanks to the CIS that we have managed to preserve, and in many areas even strengthen,
the economic, social, cultural and humanitarian ties our peoples
developed over centuries of living in a single state.
The economy has always been, and remains, one of our priorities for cooperation.
The CIS countries work closely together in trade, investment and high technology. Of course, we would like to move faster and work more effectively in this area. That is certainly true. Nevertheless,
progress is being made.
📈
Notably,
Russia’s trade with its CIS partners exceeded $110 billion in 2025 and grew by a further 12% in the first half of this year
.
Our countries have also established effective coordination in tackling
financial and economic offences, money laundering and corruption
. We are implementing
joint programmes
to combat the criminal use of digital technologies, organised crime, drug trafficking, terrorism and extremism. Our law enforcement agencies and special services maintain
close operational contacts
.
A number of useful new decisions on
criminal justice, cybercrime prevention and border protection
have been submitted for approval at this Summit, and
Russia supports the
m.
🌐
I am pleased to note that
the CIS countries unanimously support the establishment of a fair
#MultipolarWorld
order
based on the universally recognised principles of international law and the central role of the UN.
Humanitarian ties are an important part of our partnership within the CIS
. We maintain intensive exchanges in science and education, culture and tourism, healthcare and environmental protection, sport and youth policy.
As for the environment,
thanks to our hosts
, who are chairing this meeting, we will also discuss
the situation in the Caspian Sea today
– a pressing issue for many of us.
🇷🇺
The Russian language is a powerful unifying force across the vast CIS region
, as has also been noted today. In 2026,
the International Organisation for the Russian Language
began its work.
Its first ministerial meeting
took place in Moscow, setting out the main areas of work to preserve our shared Russian-language cultural and humanitarian heritage and promote the Russian language worldwide.
I have repeatedly stressed
the importance of joint efforts by the CIS countries to protect our shared history and prevent its falsification
. Young people must know the truth about our peoples’ achievements during the Soviet era and the heroic feats of our fathers and grandfathers during
the Great Patriotic War
.
More broadly, promoting a positive image of the CIS among the public, in the media and on the international stage is a particularly important task
. We expect the relevant decision being approved at today’s meeting to give fresh impetus to this work.
🤝
Following our established tradition, dear friends,
I would like to invite you all to St Petersburg on December 21
. We traditionally gather for
a friendly meeting of CIS Leaders
ahead of the New Year, giving us an opportunity to discuss current issues and future plans in an informal setting.

🇿🇦
Russia and South Africa Strengthen Cooperation in Digital Governance
On 8 October, the Russian Embassy in Pretoria hosted the graduation ceremony for 43 South African public officials who completed the advanced training programme “
Digital Transformation of the Public Administration System
”, jointly organised by the Russian Presidential Academy of National Economy and Public Administration (RANEPA) and South Africa’s National School of Government.
🎙
Addressing the graduates, Russian Ambassador
Roman Ambarov
emphasised that education is not merely about developing skills, but a foundation for
sustainable national development, intellectual and technological sovereignty, and stronger people-to-people ties.
☝️
He reaffirmed
Russia’s commitment to educational cooperation based on equality, mutual respect and due regard for national priorities,
stressing the importance of translating the considerable human potential of both countries into practical outcomes for public administration.
The Ambassador also highlighted
RANEPA’s extensive cooperation with BRICS partners,
including more than 50 cooperation agreements with institutions across BRICS countries and over 400 students from these countries studying at the Academy.
The programme marks the first initiative between RANEPA and South Africa’s National School of Government, opening new opportunities for professional development, knowledge exchange and closer institutional cooperation.
“If we want to sustain a dynamic and forward-looking partnership between our countries, we must invest not only in institutions, but also in the people who will shape its present and future. Invest in you,”
Ambassador Ambarov told the graduates.
South African participants praised the programme’s relevance to the country’s public administration priorities, describing it as “
intensive and very effective.”
🤝
The initiative underscores the shared commitment of Russia and South Africa to developing expertise, advancing digital transformation and strengthening their strategic partnership through education.

#RussiaWithAfrica
#AmbassadorAmbarov

item.description: ❗️ The latest batch of illegal anti-Russian restrictions targeting banks, individuals and merchant vessels only confirms that London has reached a dead end with its sanctions policy. Each new list is intended to demonstrate the UK authorities’ resolve, but in reality it highlights that the course they have chosen is ineffective and pointless. London is seeking to cut other countries, particularly those in the Global South, off from Russian resources. This attempt to dictate terms exposes the self-serving and neo-colonial attitude of the British establishment towards the developing world. Russia will not change its course: protecting national interests and ensuring sustainable development remain its unconditional priorities. Attempts to speak to us in the language of sanctions and threats are doomed to fail.

item.title: 🎙 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at a meeting with President of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian
item.description: 🎙 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at a meeting with President of Iran Masoud Pezeshkian (Turkmenbashi, October 8, 2026) 💬 Vladimir Putin: We met quite recently in Bishkek at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Summit . Today, we have an opportunity to discuss the development of our relations, the situation in the region and how these processes are unfolding. As for bilateral relations, I would like to note that they are developing positively on the basis of our fundamental Treaty , signed early last year. 📈 Progress in the economic sphere is certainly positive. Trade grew by more than 21% in 2025, and this trend continued in the first seven months of this year. Our humanitarian cooperation , I believe, also sets a good example, with numerous events taking place in both Russia and Iran. 🤝 Overall, our relations are growing stronger . I would ask you to convey my very best wishes to Iran’s Supreme Leader for his well-being and every success. Of course, the most pressing issue today is the situation in the region . We know that Iran is making concrete efforts to end the conflict that broke out in the region through no fault of its own . Iran has once again put forward new proposals to resolve the situation by peaceful means. You know our position, Mr President. For our part, we are ready to do everything in our power to help you resolve this situation . We have an opportunity to discuss all these issues. 🇷🇺 🇮🇷 #RussiaIran
